name: postgresql_trigger_arguments
description: PostgreSQL trigger function and procedure arguments do not block catalog construction
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE audit_events (id uuid PRIMARY KEY, payload jsonb NOT NULL); CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION audit_row() RETURNS TRIGGER LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RAISE NOTICE '%', TG_ARGV[0]; RETURN NULL; END; $$; CREATE TRIGGER audit_events_insert AFTER INSERT ON audit_events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_row('api_key'); CREATE TRIGGER audit_events_update AFTER UPDATE ON audit_events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE audit_row('legacy_key'); CREATE TABLE audit_targets (id uuid PRIMARY KEY)
